name: Skanos's power and Armix's compound count are read as the ability is fired
notes: Checked for the graveyard neighbours (handoff 2026-11-22). Skanos, Dragon Vassal attacks with Goblin Guide: another target attacking creature gets +X/+0, X = Skanos's power as the trigger is fired (4), so a Giant Growth on Skanos afterwards changes nothing: Goblin Guide 6/2. Armix, Filigree Thrasher's "When you do" (the discard done): artifacts you control (Armix, Ornithopter) plus artifact cards in your graveyard (Ornithopter, Sol Ring) = 4, the opponent's Craw Wurm 2/0.

scryfallData.name: Craw Wurm
scryfallData.flavor_text: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

scryfallData.name: Skanos, Dragon Vassal
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Specialize {4}
Whenever Skanos, Dragon Vassal attacks, another target attacking creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is Skanos's power.
scryfallData.flavor_text: "Do not place your aggression on one if you cannot handle the wrath of many."

scryfallData.name: Goblin Guide
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Haste
Whenever this creature attacks, defending player reveals the top card of their library. If it's a land card, that player puts it into their hand.
scryfallData.flavor_text: "I've been all over this world. I even remember some of those places."

scryfallData.name: Armix, Filigree Thrasher
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Whenever Armix attacks, you may discard a card. When you do, target creature defending player controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of artifacts you control plus the number of artifact cards in your graveyard.
